name: Stainless Steel Pressure Cooker
shortDescription: Induction-ready steel cooker with safety valve and gasket
description: A heavy-gauge stainless steel pressure cooker with a sandwich bottom that works on gas stoves and induction cooktops. The outer-lid design, weight valve and metallic safety plug make daily dal, rice and rajma quick and safe. Comes with a spare gasket.

images.alt: Aluminium-look pressure cooker on a kitchen stove

features: Metallic safety plug and pressure regulator

name: Pre-Seasoned Iron Dosa Tawa
shortDescription: Flat cast iron tawa for dosa, roti and paratha
description: A thick pre-seasoned iron tawa that heats evenly for crisp dosas and soft phulkas. Gets better with every use and adds natural iron to food. Long riveted handle stays cool on the gas flame.

images.alt: Two black iron tawas with wooden handles on newspaper
Round iron tawa resting on a work surface

name: Cast Iron Kadai with Handles
shortDescription: Deep iron kadai for frying, sabzi and curries
description: A deep, heavy cast iron kadai that holds heat well for deep frying pakoras and slow-cooking sabzis. Two sturdy loop handles make it easy to lift off the flame. Pre-seasoned with vegetable oil.

images.alt: Black cast iron kadai with two handles
Two iron woks on a gas stove

name: Stainless Steel Masala Dabba 7 Containers
shortDescription: Round spice box with 7 bowls, spoon and see-through lid
description: The classic Indian masala dabba in polished stainless steel with seven bowls for haldi, mirchi, jeera, rai and more. A tight lid keeps spices fresh and a small spoon is included. Fits easily beside the stove.

images.alt: Open steel masala dabba with seven bowls of spices
Top view of steel spice box filled with colourful spices

name: Stainless Steel Tiffin Box
shortDescription: Stackable steel lunch carrier with clip lock
description: A leak-resistant stainless steel tiffin carrier with stackable containers and a carry handle with clip lock. Perfect for office lunches and school dabbas. Keeps rice, dal and sabzi separate.

images.alt: Three-tier stainless steel tiffin carrier with red handle
Opened steel tiffin showing separate containers

name: Chopping Board
shortDescription: Reversible cutting board in wood or food-grade plastic
description: A sturdy chopping board for vegetables, fruits and meat with a handle for easy hanging. Choose solid acacia wood for a classic look or food-grade plastic that is light and easy to wash. Non-slip and knife-friendly.

images.alt: Wooden chopping board with handle cut-out
Green plastic chopping board with handle

name: Stackable Plastic Storage Crate
shortDescription: Ventilated heavy-duty crate for shop and home storage
description: A tough ventilated plastic crate that stacks safely for vegetable shops, godowns and home storage. Reinforced corners carry heavy loads. Popular with retailers for bulk buying.

images.alt: Stacks of blue and yellow plastic crates

name: Multipurpose Plastic Basket with Handle
shortDescription: Lightweight ventilated basket for vegetables and laundry
description: A lightweight perforated plastic basket with a strong handle for vegetables, fruit, toys or clothes. Easy to wash and dries quickly. A must-have for every home.

images.alt: Orange plastic basket with handle on a drying rack

name: Plastic Bucket with Lid
shortDescription: Food-grade bucket with tight lid and steel handle
description: A food-grade plastic bucket with a snap-fit lid for storing water, flour, pickles or cleaning supplies. The steel handle carries heavy loads comfortably. Stackable when empty.

images.alt: Stacked white plastic buckets with lids
Yellow plastic bucket with white lid

name: Ventilated Laundry Basket with Lid
shortDescription: 40L laundry hamper with airflow cut-outs and handles
description: A tall laundry basket with ventilation slots that keep clothes fresh until wash day. The lid keeps the room tidy and two side handles make carrying to the washing machine easy. Fits neatly in a bathroom corner.

images.alt: Mint green plastic laundry basket with lid
Red ventilated plastic laundry basket

name: Clothes Hangers Set
shortDescription: Slim non-slip hangers for shirts, kurtas and trousers
description: Durable hangers with a 360-degree swivel hook and notches for straps. Slim profile saves wardrobe space. Strong enough for jackets and heavy kurtas.

images.alt: Orange plastic clothes hanger
Rows of hangers displayed on a wall

name: Round Clip Hanger with 16 Pegs
shortDescription: Drying hanger for socks, undergarments and baby clothes
description: A round hanging dryer with 16 pegs for socks, handkerchiefs and baby clothes. Hang it from a rod, balcony grill or ceiling hook. Pegs hold firmly even on windy balconies.

images.alt: White round plastic clip hanger with pegs

name: Spin Mop Refill Head
shortDescription: Microfibre replacement head for round spin mops
description: A dense microfibre refill head that fits most round spin mop buckets. Picks up dust and hair and wrings almost dry in the spinner. Replace every three to four months for best results.

images.alt: Spin mop with white microfibre head on a tiled floor
Round microfibre spin mop head on tiles

name: Soft Grass Broom
shortDescription: Traditional phool jhadu with firm grip handle
description: A soft grass broom for sweeping fine dust from tiled and marble floors. The bound handle gives a firm, comfortable grip. Sheds minimally and lasts for months.

images.alt: Soft grass broom with pink handle against a green wall
Natural grass broom with wooden handle

name: Long Handle Dustpan and Broom Set
shortDescription: Upright dustpan with broom for no-bend sweeping
description: An upright dustpan with a long handle and matching broom so you can sweep without bending. The rubber lip collects fine dust in one pass. Great for shops and offices.

images.alt: Long-handle dustpans with brooms displayed outside a shop

name: Microfibre Flat Mop
shortDescription: 360-degree swivel flat mop with washable pad
description: A flat mop with a 360-degree swivel head that reaches under beds and sofas. The washable microfibre pad works wet or dry. Telescopic handle adjusts to your height.

images.alt: Flat microfibre mop on a wooden floor

name: Stainless Steel Scrubber
shortDescription: Steel wool scrubber for kadais, tawas and burnt pans
description: A tightly wound stainless steel scrubber that removes burnt-on food from kadais, tawas and cookers without rusting. Rinses clean and keeps its shape. Value packs for daily use.

images.alt: Packaged stainless steel scouring pad

name: Nitrile Grip Work Gloves
shortDescription: Coated gloves for cleaning, gardening and DIY
description: Breathable knit gloves with a nitrile-coated palm for a strong grip on wet or oily surfaces. Ideal for heavy cleaning, gardening and handling tools. Washable and reusable.

images.alt: Pair of red and black coated work gloves

name: 6 Socket Extension Board with USB
shortDescription: Surge-protected power strip with individual switches
description: A 6-socket extension board with surge protection, child-safe shutters and two USB charging ports. Universal sockets accept Indian and international plugs. Thick copper cord for safe everyday use.

images.alt: White extension board with colourful universal sockets and USB ports
White multi-socket power strip

name: Rechargeable LED Lantern
shortDescription: Portable camping and power-cut lantern
description: A rechargeable LED lantern for power cuts, camping and night travel. Gives up to 8 hours of light on a full charge with two brightness modes. The carry handle doubles as a hook.

images.alt: Orange and black portable LED lantern

name: Foldable Wooden Clothes Drying Stand
shortDescription: Space-saving indoor drying rack
description: A folding drying stand with smooth wooden rails that holds a full load of washing indoors or on the balcony. Folds flat behind a door when not in use. No assembly needed.

images.alt: Wooden drying rack with clothes hanging

name: Rechargeable LED Searchlight Torch
shortDescription: Long-range torch with side panel light
description: A powerful rechargeable searchlight with a long-throw LED and a side COB panel for area lighting. Ideal for power cuts, night security rounds and outdoor use. Built-in battery charges from the mains.

images.alt: Red rechargeable LED searchlight torch with side panel

name: Aluminium LED Flashlight
shortDescription: Pocket-size metal torch with bright LED
description: A compact aluminium flashlight with a bright LED and anti-slip grip. Runs on AA batteries and fits in a pocket or bag. Water-resistant for monsoon use.

images.alt: Three silver metal flashlights
Silver aluminium flashlight standing upright

name: Kitchen Weighing Scale with Bowl
shortDescription: 5 kg mechanical scale with removable bowl
description: A mechanical kitchen scale with a removable mixing bowl and clear dial for baking, portioning and weighing produce. No batteries needed. Weighs up to 5 kg in 20 g steps.

images.alt: White mechanical kitchen scale with mixing bowl
Kitchen scale with white bowl on a wooden table

name: Screwdriver Set
shortDescription: Flat and Phillips screwdrivers with cushion grip
description: Chrome-vanadium screwdrivers with magnetic tips and cushioned two-tone grips. Covers common flat and Phillips screws for furniture, switchboards and appliances. A staple for every home toolkit.

images.alt: Two screwdrivers with orange and black handles
Black screwdriver on a wooden surface

name: Claw Hammer with Fibreglass Handle
shortDescription: Forged steel claw hammer with anti-shock grip
description: A forged steel claw hammer with a fibreglass handle that absorbs shock. The curved claw pulls nails easily. Suitable for carpentry, home repair and fitting work.

images.alt: Claw hammer with red and black handle
Close-up of a steel claw hammer head

name: Flexible Measuring Tape 1.5 m
shortDescription: Soft tailor's tape in cm and inches
description: A soft, flexible measuring tape marked in centimetres and inches on both sides. Ideal for tailoring, body measurements and measuring curved surfaces. Fibreglass core does not stretch.

images.alt: Rolled green flexible measuring tape
Coiled cloth measuring tape

name: 12V Cordless Drill Driver
shortDescription: Compact drill with keyless chuck and LED light
description: A compact 12V cordless drill driver for drilling into wood, metal and walls with the right bit and driving screws. The 18+1 torque settings and keyless chuck make it easy for beginners. Includes charger and carry case.

images.alt: Red cordless drill with battery pack
Two green cordless drill drivers

name: Pliers Set 3 Piece
shortDescription: Combination, long-nose and cutting pliers
description: A three-piece pliers set with combination, long-nose and diagonal cutting pliers. Induction-hardened jaws grip and cut wire cleanly. Insulated handles for comfort.

images.alt: Pliers with orange and green handles
Two pairs of steel combination pliers

name: Aluminium Tool Kit Case 108 Pieces
shortDescription: Imported tool kit with sockets, spanners and screwdrivers
description: An imported 108-piece tool kit in a lockable aluminium case with sockets, spanners, screwdrivers, pliers and a hammer. Each tool has its own slot so nothing goes missing. Great for workshops and home mechanics.

images.alt: Open aluminium tool case full of tools
Blue tool kit case with pliers, wrenches and screwdrivers
